answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard.
